# Actions

On its turn, a creature can move up to its Speed and take one action. A Bonus Action or Reaction is available only when a rule or offered feature supplies one; a creature can take no more than one of each before that resource refreshes.

- Treat each offered Attack or Multiattack option as complete. Do not splice its attacks or add an unoffered ability.
- Dash uses the action to add movement for the current turn.
- Disengage uses the action and prevents the creature's movement from provoking Opportunity Attacks for the rest of that turn.
- Dodge uses the action and supplies its defined defenses until the start of the creature's next turn, subject to the action's requirements.
- End Turn is a complete offered option. Submit its id without manufacturing another action.

The current turn context is authoritative for which options and action resources remain.
